text:
Tess: Quick sync thread — final GA checklist for the ThinClient launch. Need owners for SLA sign-off, billing-smoke, docs/runbook, canary, and dashboards. Can we lock?
Omar: I can own SLA validation and synthetic perf runs. Proposal: hosted p99 <= 240ms, availability 99.95% for GA window.
Ben: Ill take canary and rollback policy. Suggested ramp: warmup 30m @2%, 6h @10%, 12h @50%, then full. Auto-rollback if p99 >300ms or errors >0.25% for 5m.
Clara: I'll handle docs + billing examples. Need a billing-smoke script and a sample invoice to embed in the howto.
Tess: Ops, please create intake tickets and set canary schedule. @ops-bot
ops-bot: Created INF-7001 (SLA tests), INF-7002 (Canary), INF-7003 (Billing-smoke). Links: https://go/infra/INF-7002
Omar: Test plan: 1) synthetic 40k QPS for 20m measure p95/p99; 2) replay 4h prod mix at 15k QPS. Pass = p99 <=240ms and sustained error-rate <0.1%. Will post results here.
Ben: Observability asks: per-route p95/p99, KV-cache hit rate, traffic split, and a regression alert tied to eval set. I'll wire the canary decision hook.
Clara: Billing-smoke checklist:
```
- Send 100 requests across short/med/long seqs
- Verify invoice line items show model + tokens + surcharges
- Confirm example monthly cost for 50k reqs
```
Tess: GA go/no-go checklist (short):
- SLA tests green (Omar)
- Billing-smoke completed (Clara + Finance)
- Canary executed with no rollbacks for 24h at >=50% (Ben + SRE)
- Runbook and user docs published (Clara)
- Dashboards + regression alerts live (Omar)
If any fail -> hold GA and run rollback.
Ben: I'll land the canary scripts this afternoon.
Clara: Drafting docs now, will @mention reviewers when ready.
Omar: Scheduling synthetic runs for tomorrow AM; will upload artifacts.
Tess: Thanks all  flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
